description: This Java class 'DeletePolicyEntryStrategy' implements a command handling strategy for deleting a policy entry within a policy management system. It extends abstract command strategy and provides logic to validate and remove specified policy entries, generating appropriate result events or errors.

classes.name: DeletePolicyEntryStrategy
classes.description: Final class that implements the deletion handling for a specific policy entry command within the policy management system.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the deletion of a policy entry, validating presence, applying removal, and returning a result with a corresponding event, or an error if validation fails.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag associated with the previous policy entity before deletion for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional as no entity tag is generated after deletion.
